origin_detail: XY bounding-box center of body; bottom is z=0
layer_semantics: Integer bottom Z divided by 3.2 mm. Bricks span three units; plates span one. Use actual position_mm for explosion.

metrics.effort_basis: Unmeasured planning estimate: 10-25 seconds per larger part plus 12-30 minutes sorting; NOT print time.

assembly.sequence: Two foundation plate courses, then increasing actual Z. All parts descend from above.
limitations: Stud-wall-tube clearance and body containment still require native evidence.
Grid-column insertion does not model hands, tools, printed shrinkage, friction or accumulated loads.
assembly.insertion_sweep_scope: Actual native owned-column containment, all fixed -Z poses and grid interfaces plus the default wall/tube/post continuous-clearance envelope and BRep insertion/bearing samples. Printed dimensional variation, hands, tools, friction, full loads and physical retention are UNKNOWN.

foundation.basis: Only the character's ground projection; independent two-plate low foundation, no copied tiered display base

attribution.creator: martinwoodward/octoprints contributors
attribution.changes: Uniform rescaling, grid discretization, merged individual bricks, custom joints and preview media.
attribution.endorsement: Independent noncommercial adaptation; no GitHub or LEGO sponsorship implied.

source.color_method: 3MF uniform paint slots decoded exactly; subdivided paint triangles assigned nearest uniformly painted triangle color, then nearest surface color sampled on each boundary grid cell. Interior uses base filament.
source.modified: Original public 3MF pose and proportions uniformly scaled to 172.8 mm, then independently adapted to 8 mm practical common bricks; two 3.2 mm foundation plate courses and top studs yield about181 mm. Outline, seams and internal supports deliberately changed; not a pixel-identical r2 fine-grid model.

sampling.method: Conservative source raster on an8mm XY /9.6mm Z grid, followed by explicit two-cell grip modules, backed source colors, crossed internal supports and common/contour packing.
sampling.subvoxel_features: Source whiskers retained by conservative cells; locally thickened to the grid, not omitted.

generation.architecture: Two-cell-wide XY shell and central crossed two-cell support webs with full staggered-brick decks every five courses; two low foundation plate courses follow the actual footprint.

two_cell_module_envelope.method: 2x2 occupancy modules filled at two source cells or any source-painted feature; nearest source color for added cells

generation.surface_color_source: Pinned 3MF; nearby internal cells inherit source surface color for grippable backed color pieces.
